name: Sinlessness
overview: Scripture emphasizes the pursuit of sinlessness as a vital aspect of the believer's walk with God, highlighting a life free from iniquity and offense. Psalms 119:3 affirms that those who walk in God's ways do no iniquity, while Acts 24:16 illustrates the importance of maintaining a conscience void of offense toward both God and men. The apostle Paul prays in Philippians 1:9-11 for believers to abound in love, knowledge, and discernment, enabling them to be sincere and blameless until Christ's return, bearing the fruits of righteousness through Jesus Christ. Furthermore, 1 Thessalonians 3:13 underscores the goal of being established unblameable in holiness before God at the coming of the Lord, demonstrating that sinlessness is integrally connected to holiness and Christ-centered living.
